consider_special_mobs.label: Consider special mobs
consider_special_mobs.tooltip: Consider nearby special mobs to pull and in counts. These are mobs that spawn during specific times and weather.

count_special_mobs_toward_minimum.label: Count special mobs toward minimum
count_special_mobs_toward_minimum.tooltip: When off, specials can still be pulled but do not count toward the minimum-to-start / minimum-to-fight thresholds.

only_start_out_of_combat.label: Only start out of combat
only_start_out_of_combat.tooltip: Wait until the InCombat flag clears before starting a new Buffing → Gathering loop. Aggro already on you still enters Fighting.

max_mob_level.label: Max mob level
max_mob_level.tooltip: Max mob level to pull, helpful for use with special mobs or mobs with varied levels

max_euclidean_distance.label: Max euclidean distance
max_euclidean_distance.tooltip: Max euclidean distance to a mob before ignoring it, useful to stop yourself getting chained across the map when considering special mobs.

min_euclidean_distance_to_return_home.label: Min distance to return to home
min_euclidean_distance_to_return_home.tooltip: After combat, if you are further away from your starting point than this, you will walk back.

return_to_start_in_waiting_phase.label: Return to your starting point after combat
return_to_start_in_waiting_phase.tooltip: Starting point is determined by where you are stood when you press Start. Paths home mounted when auto-mount is enabled.

render_debug_lines.label: Render debug lines
render_debug_lines.tooltip: While Mob Farmer is running, render red lines to valid mobs out of combat and green lines to valid mobs in combat.

maximum_battle_bell_wait_time.label: Maximum time to wait for Battle Bell
maximum_battle_bell_wait_time.tooltip: The maximum time you will wait for Battle Bell to be off of cooldown

minimum_mobs_to_start_loop.label: Minimum mobs to start
minimum_mobs_to_start_loop.tooltip: How many valid mobs need to be nearby to start the loop

minimum_mobs_to_start_fight.label: Minimum mobs to fight
minimum_mobs_to_start_fight.tooltip: How many mobs to gather before stopping to fight them. If there are no more out of combat mobs around you, it will start combat regardless.

stacking_timeout_seconds.label: Stacking timeout (seconds)
stacking_timeout_seconds.tooltip: Maximum time to spend walking to stack mobs before starting combat anyway.

mobs.label: Target mobs
mobs.tooltip: Mobs the farmer will pull and count when stacking.
